newsitem.title: france: RUGBY UNION-BOURGOIN CLINCH FIRST MAJOR TITLE.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-BOURGOIN CLINCH FIRST MAJOR TITLE.

text.p: Unheralded Bourgoin clinched their first major title when they beat Castres 18-9 in an all-French European Conference final on Sunday.
The team from the Alps failed to score a try but have now qualified for next year's European Cup, joining newly crowned champions Brive who beat Leicester in Cardiff on Saturday.
Patrice Favre and Alexandre Peclier kicked five penalties for Bourgoin and Peclier added an injury-time drop-goal to make victory safe.
